custom_waf_rules.description: Block Known Malicious User-Agents and Exploit Scanners
custom_waf_rules.expression: (http.user_agent contains "sqlmap" or http.user_agent contains "nikto" or http.user_agent contains "acunetix" or http.user_agent contains "masscan" or http.user_agent contains "nmap")

(cf.client.bot or http.user_agent contains "GPTBot" or http.user_agent contains "ClaudeBot" or http.user_agent contains "PerplexityBot" or http.user_agent contains "Googlebot" or http.user_agent contains "Applebot" or http.user_agent contains "facebookexternalhit")

custom_waf_rules.description: Rate Limit Dynamic Mutation & Integrity Endpoints
